profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a full stack software engineer with a passion for building high quality products and learning new technology. I build web applications & mobile apps, and have over 10 years of professional experience. I love refining my skills throughout the entire tech stack; from databases & SQL queries, to backend code with Ruby and PHP, to frontend with CSS, Javascript and React.

positions.title: Co-founder & Founding Engineer
positions.description:
Helped architect and build the core ChurchAI platform from the ground up, selecting and implementing the primary technical stack across NestJS, Next.js, TypeScript, MongoDB, TailwindCSS, and shadcn/ui. Contributed across backend, frontend, product architecture, and developer tooling to move the product from early concept into a working SaaS platform.

AI Product Development: Led early development of AI-powered product workflows, including journey automation concepts, church engagement tooling, and internal AI-assisted development patterns to accelerate planning, prototyping, debugging, and feature delivery.

Platform Architecture: Designed and contributed to scalable backend/frontend patterns for multi-module church management, including contacts, events, attendance, journeys, admin workflows, and dashboard experiences. Helped establish architectural direction for a modern full-stack TypeScript platform.
Engineering Process & CI/CD — Set up and improved development workflows, including CI/CD foundations, deployment processes, code organization, and AI-assisted engineering practices to help the team ship faster with better consistency.

Product & Strategy: Worked closely with the founding team to translate product ideas, church feedback, and accelerator/investor-readiness goals into practical technical plans, early features, and iterative releases.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Project Management · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · MongoDB · NestJS · Next.js

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description: Owner of Kitfox Design LLC. We create custom web applications, mobile apps, and aid in web design.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained multiple web applications, including:

- A LMS (Learning Management System) that contains a variety of learning modules, which includes: videos, quizzes, document management, project quotes, commissions, along with dashboards and administration tools.

- A Web application that monitors thousands of daily system backups. Includes a variety of API integrations which tracks thousands of different system across the nation. Provides real-time insights and alerting.

Responsible for full stack development, including:
- Backend: Ruby on Rails, PHP (slim framework), MySQL, Postgres
- Frontend: ReactJS, vanilla javascript (ES6), JQuery, HTML (vanilla and templating engines), CSS3 (Sass & 
   Bootstrap)
- Devops: Github maintenance (for both CI/CD & git repo), AWS (EC2, S3 & transcoders), Heroku, Docker & 
   Sentry.

positions.title: Contract Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on management system for sober living homes as well as mobile app for residents.

-  Sober Living Management software included organizations with multiple locations, manager notes, resident intake forms, and recurring payments. 

- mobile app(iOS & Android) included events, meeting reminders and location tracking for reporting and checking into addiction meetings.

Responsible for full stack & mobile app technologies used:
- Mobile App: React-native, Redux
- Backend: Ruby on Rails, Postgres, sidekiq(for scheduling)
- Frontend: ReactJS, vanilla javascript (ES6), HTML (vanilla and templating engines), CSS3 (Sass)
- Devops: Github, CircleCi, AWS, & Heroku

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a software engineer with IES I created new features and maintained  our existing in-house Custom CMS called 1.0,  redesigned our mobile app, built custom client projects, and worked with our Cyberschool Platform. 

- 1.0 was used by businesses(construction, petroleum, agriculture), non-profits(CAPs & CASAs), and dental associations. Even being featured on the national CASA website. It included custom designed websites with backend text editors, donations, memberships, custom forms, alerts

- I redesigned our Cyberschool mobile app used by school districts nationwide to have a dynamic UI with design templates. This app included news & events,  push notifications, image gallery, and bullying reporting.

- I built custom client projects such as a referral system for Roseland school district with multiple schools used by teachers and counselors to keep track of student issues and behavior

- I also worked with our Cyberschool platform used by thousands of schools to pull data for our Cyberschool app.

Full stack development, utilizing: 
- Mobile App: Ionic Framework, AngularJS, HTML & CSS, AWS for push notifications
- Backend: Adobe Coldfusion,  MYSQL(sql queries with no ORM), Ruby on Rails
- Frontend: Javascript, JQuery, BackboneJS, HTML & CSS, Bootstrap
- Bitbucket for Git

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I developed on the crewEyes platform by CSS Construction The crewEyes platform had employee time entries, wages, invoices, equipment tracking, as well as reports and administrative dashboards. the crewEyes platform was written in c# and asp.net with new portions written in Adobe Coldfusion

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Initially I started with fixing bugs & implementing custom designs from adobe fireworks into HMTL & CSS. As a software engineer with IES I created new features and maintained  our existing in-house Custom CMS called 1.0,  our mobile app, and custom client projects.
